result.rationale: I-595 Express, LLC is the missing DBFOM PortCo. Current equity is 87.5% through TIAA's I 595 Toll Road, LLC and 12.5% through ACS Infrastructure Development, Inc.; no later sale or pending transaction was found.

identityResolution.boundary: Count one 35-year DBFOM PortCo. FDOT is roadway owner, toll authority and overseer. Lanes, roads, ramps, interchanges, contractors, O&M/toll entities and financing SPVs are components or counterparties, not PortCos.

currentDirectOwners.fund: TIAA General Account / insurance-company balance sheet

ownershipResolution.chain: TIAA -> 100% TIAA Infrastructure Investments, LLC -> 100% I 595 Toll Road, LLC -> 87.5% PortCo. Record one TIAA/Nuveen owner. This is TIAA's General Account chain, not its Real Estate Account or a disclosed external fund.

operatingResolution.profile: Operating availability-payment highway DBFOM: about 10.5 miles in Broward County, Florida, from I-75/Sawgrass to just west of I-95.
operatingResolution.configuration: Three reversible variable-toll managed lanes, eastbound AM/westbound PM, plus reconstructed mainline, frontage roads, ramps, bridges and Turnpike connection.
operatingResolution.term: Executed and financially closed 2009-03-03 for 35 years; scheduled expiry 2044 after about five construction and 30 O&M years.
operatingResolution.roles: The PortCo financed, built, operates and maintains the corridor for performance-based availability payments. FDOT sets tolls, collects/retains toll revenue and operates toll equipment.
operatingResolution.market: South Florida motorists, buses and commercial traffic; about 180,000 vehicles/day. Operating U.S. transportation infrastructure.

acquisitionExitCheck.awardClose: ACS selected October 2008; notice 2008-10-24. Concession execution/financial close 2009-03-03 with ACS at 100%.
acquisitionExitCheck.tiaaEntry: Announced/agreed 2011-10-19; legal effectiveness 2011-12-07. ACS sold 50% to I 595 Toll Road, LLC and retained 50%.
acquisitionExitCheck.2019Sale: Completed 2019-12-10: ACS sold 75% of its 50%, or 37.5% of the PortCo, to TIAA's vehicle; resulting stakes 87.5%/12.5%.
acquisitionExitCheck.laterResult: No later equity transfer, new investor, default, termination or signed pending deal found. The 2015 refinancing and TIFIA/bank/note financings are debt-only.

milestones.event: FDOT final acceptance; long-term O&M underway.
